```{r setup, include = knitr::is_html_output(), error = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(JanisHelpers)

# group colours, used by plot_box() / plot_population() / plot_paired()
options(JanisHelpers.group_colors = c(treated = "#00BFC4", control = "#F8766D"))

# Everything loaded from the DB lives in one list. The connection is opened
# read-only and closed again inside local(), so only `dat` is left behind.
dat <- local({
  db_path <- "~/databases/<project>/<project>.duckdb"
  con <- DBI::dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb(), path.expand(db_path), read_only = TRUE)
  on.exit(DBI::dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE))
  db_load_experiment(
    con,
    experiment = "<experiment code>",
    group_levels = c("treated", "control"),
    # rename long import units: c(new_name = "import_unit")
    names = NULL
  )
})
# names(dat): meta, exclusions, then one tibble per FACS panel / ELISA / histology file

# Derived data goes back into dat, e.g.:
# dat$restim_fc <- dat$restim |>
#   facs_calc_log2fc(ref_pop = "CD4+", restim_col = "condition",
#                    ref_level = "unstim", mouse_col = "mouse_id")

# Population selections used in the plots
pops <- list(
  # t_cells = c("CD4+", "CD8+")
)
```

```{r overview}
dat$exclusions |>
  distinct(mouse_id, reason)
```
